tradeoffs.J01: SELECT as the fastest high-accuracy appearance-field reference: mean IoU 0.713193, mean 0.183s, no case over one second in this run. M04 is visually almost identical. It follows exterior glass more faithfully than native-envelope variants in GleasonXAI, PESO and PUMA, but deletes some valid pale tissue and merges thin gland walls; false palette fringes persist. Retain its simple H&E-conducted field and speed, not an accuracy advance or universal one-second guarantee.
tradeoffs.M04: SELECT as the positive sampling-uncertainty branch: mean IoU 0.713193, mean 0.202s, no case over one second. Its IoU differs from J01 by only 0.000000206 and the actual masks are nearly identical, so this is mathematical branch retention, not demonstrated benefit from uncertainty. Fine septa, absent-coarse classes and common-support pale-tissue deletion remain unresolved. P04/P05/P06 do not give a convincing quality/runtime improvement.
tradeoffs.N08: SELECT as the best common-support candidate under the frozen utility: mean IoU 0.714123, adjusted 0.713619, mean 0.385s, 23 over-budget images. Some native interfaces and mixed-colour fields improve, but many overviews are almost unchanged; GleasonXAI28 remains mottled and PUMA thin channels still break. Small-region recall 0.206970 remains poor. Positive log-variance transport is retained as a distinct likelihood with a measured speed/accuracy tradeoff, not dominance on every image.
tradeoffs.N10: REJECT this common-support convex-envelope branch. Mean IoU 0.713186 and adjusted 0.713182 are slightly below J01/M04, with mean 0.212s and one over-budget image. Most full-tissue masks are nearly identical to those parents, and it cannot repair tissue removed before its envelope acts. P11 tests native support directly and replaces this branch, with its foreground leakage explicitly retained as a limitation.
tradeoffs.C17: SELECT the fast palette active-set branch for its distinct forward model and practical behaviour on mixed RGB: mean IoU 0.710460, mean 0.142s, no over-budget image. This sacrifices aggregate utility relative to P10/P12/P09/P02. Actual BCSS interfaces and IGNITE33/GCSS32 show cases where a simpler palette decision avoids field-induced mottling or false colour bands. It still merges glands and misses absent-coarse classes; cleaner selected examples do not establish overall accuracy superiority.
tradeoffs.P01: REJECT the budgeted ordered-field ADMM implementation. Mean IoU 0.714061 brings little visual change over J01, while 142 images exceed one second and adjusted utility falls to 0.689956. Every one of 469 finite runs misses the declared convergence criterion; the maximum gradient residual is 0.0296121. Scores refer to those finite outputs, not optimized solutions. Added constraints and runtime do not resolve thin-channel and small-class failures.
tradeoffs.P02: REJECT despite a small aggregate utility advantage over C17: mean IoU 0.710574, mean 0.184s and no over-budget image. Fractional transport usually yields masks close to C17/J01 while retaining their merged glands, misplaced small islands and common-support deletion. Retain C17's faster and simpler palette branch for the fifth diversity slot. This is an explicit speed/model-choice tradeoff, not proof that P02 is numerically worse than C17.
tradeoffs.P03: REJECT: stain-component regions frequently collapse broad tissue compartments to the dominant class plus nuclear-scale speckle. PUMA16/24/34 and GleasonXAI05/11/26 make this failure unmistakable. Mean IoU is 0.356613, adjusted 0.356447; its better small-component recall does not compensate for destroyed broad architecture. Exact C++ component operations certify the discrete operation, not biological segmentation or useful full-pipeline acceleration.
tradeoffs.P04: REJECT: the 32-probe uncertain-winner decision produces almost the same mask as M04/J01 on most cases. Mean IoU 0.713200 is only a tiny change, but mean 2.330s and 377 over-budget images reduce utility to 0.644515. Full-matrix sampling does not restore PUMA blue classes or narrow gland separations. Numerical perturbation expense has not produced a useful visual or accuracy improvement.
tradeoffs.P05: REJECT: expected absolute colour error has mean IoU 0.712621 and utility 0.711424, below M04/J01, with 30 over-budget cases. Many overviews are almost identical; others broaden an incorrect class patch, as at PUMA17 upper-left. The changed loss does not solve shared small-region omissions, fragmented septa or background support. Its different formula is insufficient without measured practical benefit.
tradeoffs.P06: REJECT: Gaussian affinity yields mean IoU 0.713191, nearly indistinguishable from M04/J01, but mean 0.259s and five over-budget cases lower utility to 0.713150. Actual masks retain the same false fringes and merged structures across PUMA, PESO and GCSS. It adds density comparison without a demonstrated quality improvement over the simpler retained appearance branches.
tradeoffs.P07: REJECT despite mean IoU 0.716366, higher than N08. Full SPD covariance transport occasionally improves boundaries, including GleasonXAI30, but mean 1.942s and 393 over-budget cases reduce utility to 0.667278. Most actual masks remain close to faster methods and fine channels are still lost. This expressly honours the one-second penalty rather than choosing raw overlap alone.
tradeoffs.P08: REJECT despite local improvements in GleasonXAI28/30. Mean IoU 0.712728 and utility 0.711642 are below N08; 28 cases exceed one second. Derivative-density decisions change island widths but often retain the same fragmented compartments and can overexpand red, for example in PUMA30. It is a real alternative objective with insufficient cohort benefit at its observed runtime.
tradeoffs.P09: REJECT: mean IoU 0.713745 is slightly above J01/M04, but utility 0.712583 is lower after 28 over-budget cases and mean 0.456s. Shared latent noise scale changes small islands and can improve part of a contour, yet misses the same fine PUMA vessels/channels and weakens broad compartments in other fields. N08 has better aggregate IoU and utility among these likelihood alternatives.
tradeoffs.P10: REJECT despite second-best selectable utility 0.722133 and mean IoU 0.722349. Alpha-complex support creates conspicuous angular glass spikes and polygon fills in BEETLE03/08, GleasonXAI13/28/39/40 and other cases. Its high scores partly reward coverage under broad semantic polygons rather than reliable foreground anatomy. P11 retains the native-support branch with fewer angular artifacts, though it still leaks. Mean 0.447s includes 17 over-budget cases.
tradeoffs.P11: SELECT the mandatory selectable utility leader: mean IoU 0.722393, adjusted 0.722216, mean 0.424s, 19 over-budget images. Native probabilistic stain occupancy restores some labelled pale adipose tissue and generally avoids P10 triangular spikes. It also fills substantial real glass in CAMELYON/PESO/PUMA/GleasonXAI, including PUMA11 and GleasonXAI40; small-region recall is only 0.192429. Broad polygons sometimes reward that filling. This is an unresolved research branch, not validated background removal, and the B23 diagnostic control still scores higher.
tradeoffs.P12: REJECT despite third-best selectable utility 0.721260 and mean IoU 0.721836. Diffusive glass residence often creates broad rounded rectangular foreground blankets over clear glass, especially GleasonXAI05/08/20/26/40, while also cutting some valid pale borders in BCSS71/76/80. Score gains do not resolve this conflicting foreground behaviour. Mean 0.429s includes 32 over-budget images. P11 is the retained native-support experiment, with its own limitations disclosed.
tradeoffs.P13: REJECT this finite 120-step spatial-mixture TV solver: mean IoU 0.707518 and mean 14.556s give utility 0.029699; every image exceeds one second. All 469 runs miss the stated convergence criterion (maximum projected residual 0.0243154). Smooth-looking masks generally retain the same missing structures as fast C17 and do not justify the cost. This rejects the measured implementation, not the possibility of a better TV optimizer.
tradeoffs.P14: REJECT: log-ratio palette inversion has mean IoU 0.706798 and adjusted 0.706736, below C17, with five over-budget cases. Some interfaces smooth, but fragmented broad regions and gland mergers remain. 136 of 469 runs miss projected stationarity tolerance (maximum 0.00837574). Artificial converted RGB channel proportions are not validated physical compositional measurements, and this tested change offers no convincing aggregate advantage.
tradeoffs.P15: REJECT despite occasional recovery of fine epithelial linings in PESO18/38 and some PUMA23 strips. Negative-tail competition often overexpands rare colours into false halos or islands, notably PUMA09/12/39/40 and GCSS24/30/37. Mean IoU 0.689847 and adjusted 0.689735 are poor; six cases exceed one second. Local tail response is not reliable new-class discovery, and all closed-class methods still miss classes absent from coarse labels.

runtime_penalty_policy.timing: Per-image median candidate seconds, including preparation and native projection
runtime_penalty_policy.interpretation: Five IoU percentage points per excess second; no bonus below one second
runtime_penalty_policy.historical_scope: Posthoc display for cycles1-4; signed historical selections unchanged
